children: Starfighters Space filed notice setting record date Oct 27 and schedules its annual meeting for Dec 17, 2026.
Filed Notice of Meeting and Record Date with British Columbia regulator under NI 54-101.
Record date for notice, voting and beneficial ownership determination set for October 27, 2026.
Annual meeting scheduled for December 17, 2026 in Vancouver at Suite 1500, 1055 West Georgia St.
Company will pay for delivery of materials to OBOs; will not send materials directly to NOBOs.
Notice-and-Access procedures will be used for registered and beneficial holders.
